Name: Flower Meads Addon for PFM - Expanded Casks
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Addon that adds Flower Meads compatibility to Epsilon's PFM - Expanded Casks, allowing the casks to age flower meads. Intended for use with either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url] or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/707502-quality-artisan-products]Quality Artisan Products[/url] mods



This is an addon for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8416]PFM - Expanded Casks[/url] mod created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6560017]Epsilon[/url]. This is in no way affiliated with the original mod or author.
